decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the first-mint exception for the no-code reward package.
A same-message MODIFY already adjusts leaderboard reward totals to exclude the first primary mint.
A same-message MODIFY already records that no referral commission is awarded on the first primary mint.
The accepted exception concerns the already-occurring first mint and is explicitly described as a one-off with no prospective effect; the FAQ's normal no-code reward description remains unchanged.
The exception applies to a first mint without a prior NFT recipient, not to successful coded referrals.
The one-off accounting exception does not change the persistent validation messages used for prospective mints after an NFT holder exists.
Whether the first mint receives a random reward does not change the use of NFT mint numbers as referral codes.
The first-mint reward-accounting exception is unrelated to the badge set, badge names, or badge layout.
The exception does not change which already-minted NFT numbers are valid referral codes or the self-referral rule.
A one-off absence of a first-mint ticket does not change which counters, badges, or referral identifiers the metadata infrastructure must expose.
The hero describes prospective coded-referral earnings and prize participation; the historical first-mint no-code exception does not change that messaging.
The landing-page mechanics describe prospective referral earnings and prize draws, which remain unchanged by the explicitly one-off first-mint exception.
